facts.fact: The EITI country page says Senegal's commercial register (RCCM) records beneficial ownership information under Decree 2020-791, available to authorities, courts and people with a legitimate interest on request, with a registry extract covering 262 companies.

SEN.note: Only a mining cadastre is described, which is not a land title register.

facts.fact: The EITI country page says Senegal's Ministry of Mines publishes production data on its Statistiques minières web page and a public data portal, Données Ouvertes ITIE Sénégal, is run alongside the national EITI website.
